title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
